mechanism: Chlorthalidone causes electrolyte depletion and hyponatremia which can potentiate cholinergic effects of donepezil, increasing risk of syncope, bradycardia, and falls in elderly patients.
action: Monitor electrolytes regularly, particularly sodium levels; assess for symptoms of hyponatremia and cholinergic excess; consider alternative antihypertensive if significant electrolyte disturbances develop.
